estimator: S_dot_m = -<S>/(2 sqrt m), S = (grad T . u)(|u|^2 - 4T)/T^2, Euler-Maruyama, 20000 particles; statistical error about 0.001
note: At fixed dt/m the Euler bias is the same at every mass, so the fixed-step values sit about 4% high for all m; refining the step removes it and the extrapolated value agrees with 19/210 to within the statistical error. Mass dependence at m <= 0.04 is below the statistical error.
